# GSAP

GSAP and ScrollTrigger 3.15.0 are vendored from the official npm `gsap` package.

- Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/gsap/-/gsap-3.15.0.tgz
- License: https://gsap.com/standard-license
- Original license banners are retained in both scripts. Only trailing whitespace and the final blank line have been normalised.
- Verified archive SHA-512 (base64): `dMW4CWBTUK1AEEDeZc1g4xpPGIrSf9fJF960qbTZmN/QwZIWY5wgliS6JWl9/25fpTGJrMRtSjGtOmPnfjZB+A==`

Local scripts keep motion available without a third-party runtime request. Content and navigation work without GSAP; reduced-motion preferences disable movement.
